tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// chos rje dwags po lha rje'i gsung sgros/ lam mchog rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// gol sa thams cad gcod mdzad la// yang dag don ni ston mdzad cing*// chos nyid ngang du rtogs pa yi// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyu'i rkyen/ bdag po'i rkyen/ dmigs pa'i rkyen/ de ma thag pa'i rkyen te bzhi'o// log pa'i bshes gnyen 'khrul pa dang re dogs la zhen pa/ yang dag pa'i bshes gnyen ma 'khrul ba/ re dogs med pa/ gsol 'debs nus pa/ 'gal sgyur nus pa/ go 'byed nus pa'o// shes pa'i mtshan nyid/ khyad par gyi mtshan nyid/ byed pa'i mtshan nyid/ ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan nyid do// shes pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ shes rab kyis sems kyi mtshan nyid ngo shes par bya ste/ skye ba med pa chos sku| 'gag pa med pa longs sku/ gnas pa med pa sprul sku/ sku gsum brtags pa'i blo la snang ba/ tshig tu brjod 'dod kyang*/ ngo bo la ngos bzung dang bral ba blo'i yul las 'das pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ sems kyi mtshan nyid sku bzhir shes par bya'o// khyad par gyi mtshan nyid ni/ rnam rtog gang byung sems nyid yin pas/ mi spong bar sku bzhir 'khyer ba'o// byed pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ rtog pa sku bzhi yin yang byed pa po med/ chos nyid kyi sgyu ma lta bur 'gro /ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan nyid ni/ gdod ma nas sku bzhir lhun gyis grub pa yin/ de ltar chos thams cad mtshan nyid bzhi las ma 'das par shes tsa na/ lta ba'i go cha ste/ thams cad shes rab kyi yul du shes nas mtha' khegs te/ dper na bya thag pas btags pa dang 'dra'o// shes rab kyi go cha ni/ rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung*/ lag pa mnyam bzhag lus bsrang*/ mig sna rtser phab la/ shes rab kyis sems kyi mtshan nyid bltas la/ tshig tu lan gsum brjod pa ni thos pa'i shes rab bo// tshig la brten nas don go ba ni/ bsam pa'i shes rab bo// rtog pa don du shes pa ni sgom pa'i shes rab bo// shes rab kyis de ltar lag tu lon nas| rtogs pa mngon du gyur ba'i sangs rgyas zhes de la bya'o// skyabs su 'gro ba'i dbang du byas na/

de lta bu'i don rtogs shing khong du chud na/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song ba yin| chos thams cad de nyid yin pas/ rtogs pa lam du byed na/ chos la skyabs su song ba yin/ de ltar rtogs pa lam du byed pa'i mkhan po rten med pa'i rig pa las byung bas| thogs pa med pa'i shes rab dge 'dun la skyabs su song ba yin/ de lta bu'i khyad par can gyi lam de la rtogs pa ci skyes thams cad pha rol du phyin pa'i lam du 'gro/ thabs su 'gro /rtog pa nyid kyis bskul ma btab nas grogs su 'gro ste/ rtog pa gang gi mtshan nyid shes pa ni shes rab/ rtog pa thams cad lam du byung bas bsam gtan| rtog pa skyes tshad lam nyid du skyes pas/ yongs su sbyong ba'i brtson 'grus/ chos nyid zab mo'i don la mi skrag pas bzod pa/ de lta bu'i bsam gtan de la/ nyon mongs pa'i sa bon med pas/ zag pa med pa'i tshul khrims/ de lta bu'i thabs shes kyi rten 'brel lag tu blangs pas/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rje ngam ngam shugs kyis skyes nas| ci byed sems can gyi don du 'gro bas sbyin pa'o// de lta bu dang ldan pa'i lam 'di la skabs brgyad/ de ltar sgrub pa po'i lag char khyer bas phyir mi ldog pa thob ste/ sems dang rtog pa tha mi dad cing sku bzhir khyer bas/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa/ thams cad lam du shes pas/ lam shes/ sgrub pa po thabs la mkhas nas byas pa ma yin te/ gdod ma nas rtog pa rang gi mtshan nyid de ltar yin par shes pas/ gzhi shes/ rgyu lam 'bras bu ngo bo gcig tu sbyong bas/ rnam kun mngon rdzogs/ de ltar shes pas shes rab rno// shes rab kyi rtsal sbyong ba la tshegs med pas/ rtse mo/ de ltar rtog pa mi spong bar mthar gyis sgrub pas/ mthar gyis pa/ shes rab kyi gnas skabs su chos thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid shes pas| skad cig ma la byang chub pa/ thams cad chos kyi sku'i 'phrin las su longs spyod pas/

sku yongs su rdzogs so// khyad par gyi lam 'di la/ lam rnam pa lnga'i dbang du byas nas| rtog pa dge sbyor gyi grogs su 'gro bas tshogs lam/ rtog pa nyid la brten nas lam khyad par can skye bas sbyor lam/ rtog pa nyid sku bzhir myong bas mthong lam/ rtog pa gang skyes kyang sku bzhi dang mi 'bral bas sgom lam/ de nyid la nges shes skyes na/ de las phul du phyin pa'i lam gzhan bslab rgyu med pas/ mthar phyin pa'i lam mo// lam de nyid byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun du 'gro ste/ dran pa byung tshad lam du 'gro bas/ dran pa nyer bzhag rtog pa mi spong bar/ shes rab kyis rtogs pa'i mtshan nyid shes pa de nyid/ yang dag par spong ba lam de la rdzu 'phrul thams cad 'byung bas rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi/ dad pas rgyu byas/ dran pas lam byas/ brtson 'grus kyis grogs byas| de gsum ni thabs yin te/ de gsum de ltar shes pas shes rab/ thabs shes kyi rten 'brel skrun pas/ thams cad ting nge 'dzin du byung bas 'bras bu/ de ltar dbang po lnga lag tu blangs pas shes rab kyi rtsal dang*/ byang chub kyi sems 'byongs pa la tshegs med pas/ stobs lnga/ de ltar thabs shes kyi rten 'brel bskul bas shes rab kyi rtsal 'byongs| de la byang chub kyi sems skyes pas/ dran rig thams cad byang chub kyi grogs su 'gro bas/ byang chub kyi yan lag go /thams cad byang chub kyi yan lag tu shes pas/ rnam rtog la longs spyod kyang*/ rnam rtog gis mi gos par de nyid lam du 'gro bas/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'o// de ltar lta ba'i go chas chos kyi brdar sha bcad nas/ gol sa thams cad kyi mtha' khegs nas/ shes rab kyi go chas rtog pa lam du 'khyer ba'i dus su/ gong du bstan pa'i lam la shes rab kyis bsngo bgrang byed dam zhe na/ skyon med de/ lam ni sgom pa'i shes rab 'ba' zhig la byed pa yin la/

sgom pa'i shes rab ni tshig dang blo las 'das pa yin/ 'o na lam du ci ltar 'khyer/ gang la brten nas 'khyer na/ rtogs pa la brten nas| shes rab kyis dran pa la dbang bsgyur cing 'gro/ rtog pa la ci tsug blta na/ rtog pa de nyid blos mi spong bar snying du sdug par blta/ dgos par blta/ sku drin che bar blta'o| /de ltar blta ba ci ste zhe na/ yon tan thams cad kho rang la rang chas su yod la/ ngo bo nyid kyi rtog pa yin pas so// de ltar bltas pas rtog pa rang gi mtshan nyid ngo shes nas| sku bzhi ngo bo nyid kyis 'byung ste/ de ltar rtog pa lam du khyer bas ma zhi nas/ chags sdang gi rtog pa skyes na myur du mi spang bar gong gi lta ba'i go chas gtan la dbab/ de ltar byas pas rtog pa rang zhi rang dag tu 'gro ste/ dper na/ mtsho la 'khyag pa zhu ba'am/ nam mkha' la sprin dengs pa ltar song nas/ yon tan gyis chos su gyur pa thams cad 'gag med du shugs kyis 'byung ste/ yon tan de la zhen nas 'gag nas 'dug na/ de la mi gnas par/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bur shes par byas pa/ gong nas gong du shes rab kyi rtsal sbyang ngo*| /de ltar shes rab kyi rtsal gyis rnam rtog sku bzhir thul bas na/ 'dul ba zhes kyang bya/ shes rab kyis rtog pa chos nyid du mthong bas na tshad ma zhes kyang bya/ shes rab kyi rtog pa'i rtsa ba ngo shes te mtha' thams cad dang bral bas/ dbu ma zhes kyang bya'o// gnyug ma ngos 'dzin gyi man ngag yang dag pa gsang bar bya'o// //
